tools.name: find_logos
tools.description: Look up logos for domains or product names. Returns, per query: found/fallback, confidence (0 = placeholder), name, source URL and size, and public PNG/WebP/ICO/SVG URLs.

queries.description: Domains (stripe.com) or product names (Microsoft Entra ID, CoCounsel). Up to 20.

tools.name: get_logo_image
tools.description: Return one logo as an image you can look at, plus its URL. Use to check a logo before placing it. Options: size (16-256), bg (hex, white, black), pad (0-40 percent), trim.

bg.description: Background: hex like 1f2937, white or black. Default transparent.

trim.description: Cut empty border so the mark fills the frame.

tools.name: company_stack
tools.description: Find which tools a company uses (client portals, practice software, email, CRM, analytics), from its website and DNS. Every tool comes with the evidence that was observed and a confidence. Absence of a tool means no evidence was found, not that the company does not use it.

tools.name: logo_set
tools.description: Return logos as a matched set for one background and size: same visual weight and padding, full color or one tone, with warnings when a logo will not read on the background. Missing logos become neutral stand-in tiles marked standIn: true. Includes a row_url that renders the whole set as one PNG strip.

queries.description: Domains (stripe.com) or product names (Microsoft Entra ID, CoCounsel). Up to 20.

bg.description: Slide background: hex like ffffff or 1f2937.
